niche: an Australian distribution network's rooftop PV forecast for its FY2027-28 capital program: which of the eight 22 kV feeders out of one peri-urban zone substation gets the single accelerated hosting-capacity upgrade, sized on rooftop PV connected at 31 August 2029, when the city council runs solar bulk-buys this spring in a large, slow-adopting new estate and a smaller, fast-adopting one
answer: YRB27 should get the accelerated hosting capacity augmentation in the FY2027-28 capital works program. Its rooftop PV will sit 1.9 MW above its hosting capacity at 31 August 2029, 0.2 MW more than YRB24's 1.7 MW.

driver: A scheduled intervention mostly enrols units that were about to take up the outcome on their own, so its enrolments overstate what it adds by a horizon past their own dates, and a common rise in the outcome's pace between each past run's before and after windows inflates each site's own before-and-after too; only each past site read against sites whose run had not yet come, or never would, over the same calendar months gives its addition at the horizon, which carried per eligible unit leaves the largest site's increment at a fraction of its enrolments and hands the call to the site with the higher starting level.
driver_concrete: Each of the council's seven past solar bulk-buys installed about 9.3 systems per 100 owner-occupied houses without PV, but more than half of those households would have gone solar within three years anyway: read against the suburbs whose campaign had not yet run, over the same months, the campaigns added about 4.1 per 100, while each suburb's own before and after reads about 5.7 because uptake rose across the zone over the same years; carried per house without PV, Bindarra Waters adds 1.7 MW to YRB24 and Wattleview 0.7 MW to YRB27, so YRB27 is furthest over hosting capacity at 31 August 2029, where the installed systems put YRB24 first.
stump: A competent solver takes each 2026 bulk-buy's impact as the systems it will install, per home letterboxed, and files YRB24 at about 4.2 MW over hosting capacity (per house without PV YRB24 at 3.9, each suburb's own before and after YRB24 at 2.4); the step that lands it there is counting a campaign's installed systems as the PV it adds, when more than half of them would have been installed by 2029 anyway: against the suburbs whose campaign had not yet run, the seven added about 4.1 systems per 100 houses without PV, and the golden is YRB27 at about 1.9 MW.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who collapses alterations, joins legacy inverters, places NMIs on the network model, builds the procedure's trend and takes the bulk-buys' impact as their installed systems per home letterboxed files YRB24 at about 4.2 MW over hosting capacity; per owner-occupied house without PV (the textbook transfer) YRB24 at 3.9, each suburb's own before and after YRB24 at 2.4 to 2.6, and fitted models of the installed systems on pool, letterboxes, houses and penetration YRB24 at 3.7 to 5.0.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each feeder's design-point rooftop PV against its spring minimum-demand hosting capacity, with each council bulk-buy's contribution estimated as program evaluators estimate a solar bulk-buy's net effect, each past campaign suburb's first applications against suburbs whose campaign had not yet run over the same months; with another field's nouns, inverter ratings, hosting capacity and a PV purchase pulled forward from a later year have nothing to attach to.

lineage.fate: superseded 2026-10-14 at round 2: the 10/10 audit (COMPLIANT_WEAK) found the decisive step (a bulk-buy's yield per owner-occupied house still without PV) the textbook addressable-pool reflex for adoption forecasts, named by the program terms; a rough pool estimate landed the golden; the seven campaigns agreed within 0.6 per cent, a generator constant a denominator search recovers; Ask A's temporary NMIs resolved through the re-allocation log and Ask B's repeated battery capacity fell to grouping by connection; never on the portal
lineage.driver: A scheduled intervention's yield is carried to new sites from its past runs, and it is stable only per member who can still respond, those inside the intervention's area who qualify and have not already responded, a pool built by joining a membership roll through a link file to the response log; per contacted member, per qualifying member, per member without a response or per whole site each fits the past runs no better than the raw counts, so every such transfer leaves the site with the largest untouched pool at a third to a half of its yield and the call with a rival.

lineage.fate: superseded 2026-10-15 at round 3: the rule 3 audit (AT_RISK, hidden rule and rule application) found the call bound to NPP-114 in the prompt, NPP-114 4.2 stating every step but the pooled rate's denominator, and the winning basis (first applications in the year before sign-ups) a construct found only by a denominator search over seven campaigns; never on the portal
lineage.driver: A scheduled intervention's increment at a new site is carried from its past runs as a multiple of the site's own recent rate of the outcome, rebuilt per site behind a three-file join; every share of a pool (contacted, eligible, eligible and not yet responded) scatters several-fold across the past runs and hands the site with the largest untouched but slow pool several times its increment, so the call goes to that site instead of the fast one.

notes: Calibration none: the seven past campaigns are the history from which the program component is estimated, not an organ confirming a filed criterion. Pattern none; gap time then population; generators G9 (what a campaign leaves on the feeder at the design point against what it installed), G16 (the comparison the records support), G13 (the impact at the design point, after the pulled-forward installs would have come anyway). Strategy population_selection: the decisive step decides which of a campaign's installed systems are its own, its participants being selected on imminent adoption; causal_design would name the estimator (a comparison choice) and blocks on ban.strategy against task128 v3, so the author may force it in place of population_selection. Gate G method_or_model_selection: the counterfactual is chosen among the installed count, the suburb's own before and after and the not-yet-treated suburbs over the same months, and the records (the post-opening dip, the comparison suburbs' pace) select the last. Layer 2 estimand_identification, own:bulk-buy-net-uplift-against-not-yet-treated-suburbs.
